LanguageData.GR_Settings_ShowAdvancedDebugInformation: Show advanced GateRim SG-1 debug information
Expose technical prototype diagnostics such as persistent symbiote IDs, raw cooldown ticks and detailed lifecycle traces in Player.log.
RimWorld developer mode always exposes advanced GateRim SG-1 diagnostics, regardless of this setting. Warnings and errors always remain visible in Player.log.
